text_en: Suppose a man enters into marriage with a woman, but she does not please him because he finds something objectionable about her, and so he writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; she then leaves his house
text_cn: 如果一人娶了妻，占有她之后，在她身上发现了什么难堪的事，因而不喜悦她，便给她写了休书，交在她手中，叫她离开他的家，

text_en: and goes off to become another man’s wife.
text_cn: 而这女子走出了他的家，又去嫁给了另一人为妻，

text_en: Then suppose the second man dislikes her, writes her a bill of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house (or the second man who married her dies);
text_cn: 如果后夫又憎恶她，给她写了休书，交在她手中，叫她离开他的家，或者娶她为妻的后夫死了，

text_en: her first husband, who sent her away, is not permitted to take her again to be his wife after she has been defiled; for that would be abhorrent to the Lord , and you shall not bring guilt on the land that the Lord your God is giving you as a possession.
text_cn: 那么，那休她的前夫，在她受了污辱之后，不能再娶她为妻，因为这在上主面前是可憎恶的事；你不可使上主你的天主赐给你作产业的土地陷于罪恶。

text_en: When a man is newly married, he shall not go out with the army or be charged with any related duty. He shall be free at home one year, to be happy with the wife whom he has married.
text_cn: 人娶了新妇，不应从军出征，也不可派他担任什么职务；他应在家享受一年自由，使他新娶的妻子快活。

text_en: No one shall take a mill or an upper millstone in pledge, for that would be taking a life in pledge.
text_cn: 不可拿人的磨，或上面的一块磨石作抵押，因为这无异是拿人的性命作抵押。

text_en: If someone is caught kidnaping another Israelite, enslaving or selling the Israelite, then that kidnaper shall die. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
text_cn: 若发现一人拐带了以色列子民中的一个兄弟，叫他充当奴隶，或将他贩卖于人，这拐子应处死刑：这样你由你中间铲除了这邪恶。

text_en: Guard against an outbreak of a leprous skin disease by being very careful; you shall carefully observe whatever the levitical priests instruct you, just as I have commanded them.
text_cn: 遇有癞病的情形，应全照肋未司祭指教你们的，谨慎遵行。我怎样吩咐了他们，你们就怎样遵守执行。

text_en: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam on your journey out of Egypt.
text_cn: 你应记得你们出埃及后，在途中，上主你的天主对米黎盎所做的事。

text_en: When you make your neighbor a loan of any kind, you shall not go into the house to take the pledge.
text_cn: 几时你借给你近人什么，不可走进他家索取抵押；

text_en: You shall wait outside, while the person to whom you are making the loan brings the pledge out to you.
text_cn: 应站在外面，等那借贷的人把抵押给你拿出来。

text_en: If the person is poor, you shall not sleep in the garment given you as the pledge.
text_cn: 倘若他是个贫苦人，你不可带着他的抵押去睡觉。

text_en: You shall give the pledge back by sunset, so that your neighbor may sleep in the cloak and bless you; and it will be to your credit before the Lord your God.
text_cn: 反之，在日落时，务要将抵押还给他，好叫他睡在自己的外衣里祝福你；这在上主你的天主面前，算是你的功德。

text_en: You shall not withhold the wages of poor and needy laborers, whether other Israelites or aliens who reside in your land in one of your towns.
text_cn: 贫苦可怜的佣工，不论是你的一个兄弟，或是你城镇地区内的一个外方人，你不应欺压他，

text_en: You shall pay them their wages daily before sunset, because they are poor and their livelihood depends on them; otherwise they might cry to the Lord against you, and you would incur guilt.
text_cn: 应在当天，交给他工钱，不要等到日落；因为他贫苦，他急需工钱用，免得他对你不满而呼求上主，你就不免有罪了。

text_en: Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall children be put to death for their parents; only for their own crimes may persons be put to death.
text_cn: 不可为儿子的罪处死父亲，亦不可为父亲的罪处死儿子：每人应为自己的罪被处死刑。

text_en: You shall not deprive a resident alien or an orphan of justice; you shall not take a widow’s garment in pledge.
text_cn: 不可侵犯外方人或孤儿的权利，不可拿寡妇的衣服作抵押；

text_en: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this.
text_cn: 应记得你在埃及曾做过奴隶，上主你的天主曾将你由那里救出：为此我吩咐你应遵行这条命令。

text_en: When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it; it shall be left for the alien, the orphan, and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all your undertakings.
text_cn: 当你在田间收割庄稼时，如在田中忘下了一捆，不要再回去拾取，要留下给外方人、孤儿和寡妇，好叫上主你的天主在你做的一切事上祝福你。

text_en: When you beat your olive trees, do not strip what is left; it shall be for the alien, the orphan, and the widow.
text_cn: 当你打橄榄树时，不要再回去打树枝上所剩的，应留给外方人、孤儿和寡妇。

text_en: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, do not glean what is left; it shall be for the alien, the orphan, and the widow.
text_cn: 当你收获葡萄时，不要再摘取所剩下的，应留给外方人、孤儿和寡妇。

text_en: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I am commanding you to do this.
text_cn: 总应记得你在埃及地曾做过奴隶：为此我吩咐你应遵行这条命令。
